name: Arden, Rubyfront of Fire
summary: The Human tutorial's Rubyfront: it pays HP to push the attacks, and the Eternal Flame pays them back.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: This turn you attacked with at least 3 Human Entities. Put a Human Entity from your hand into your Retire Zone, then flip.

faceA.name: Arden, Rubyfront of Fire

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 13 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: The first time each of your turns a Human Entity you control attacks, you may pay 1 HP. If you do, that Entity gets +1 Power until end of turn.

pactWord.name: Spark
pactWord.text: a Human Entity you control gets +1 Power until end of turn.

pactCall.name: Call to the Flame
pactCall.text: the next Human Entity you play this turn costs 1 less Flux.

faceA.flavor: He swore to no one. The fire is enough.

faceB.name: Eternal Flame

effect.text: The first time each of your turns you attack with at least 2 Human Entities, you gain 2 HP.

oathWord.name: Flare
oathWord.text: a Human Entity you control gets +2 Power until end of turn.

oathCall.name: Ardent Call
oathCall.text: you may put a Human Entity with Flux cost 2 or less from your hand onto your Front without paying its Flux cost.

oathCharge.name: Wildfire
oathCharge.text: the Human Entities you control get +1 Power and gain Surge until end of turn.

faceB.flavor: A flame is worth as much as those who keep it burning.
